title: Autocomplete search component
body:
Hi,

I'm looking for a way to display suggestions on a search field, I saw that you have a autocomplete.js library but it looks outdated. I saw that there is a connectAutocomplete connector in instantsearch.js but the documentation about how to implement it is also outdated (404 links).

Do you have any examples of a implementation of an angular 2+ / ssr / autocomplete search ?

Thanks !
